# Mann Patel

> Personal portfolio of Mann Patel, showcasing website building, AI automation, and the creator's work on Mathgem.

## Overview

Mann Patel is a website builder and AI automation builder. This portfolio presents selected work, capabilities, and projects.

## Main areas

- **Website building** — design and development of polished, modern websites for businesses.
- **AI automation** — workflow and automation solutions built with tools such as n8n.
- **Mathgem** — an AI-powered learning platform for mathematics and science, designed around interactive visual explanations.

## Primary project

- [Mathgem](https://mathgem.in/) — interactive learning platform for mathematics and science.
